dedupe_keys.name: best of ps ranked list of open source power system analysis projects

description: best-of-ps is a ranked list of popular open-source projects for power system analysis, updated weekly. It currently lists 160 projects grouped into 16 categories, including phasor and electromagnetic transient simulation, steady-state simulation, interfaces, gas simulation, co-simulation, optimisation modelling languages and solvers, machine learning for power grids, visualisation and power system data. Projects are ranked by a popularity score computed automatically from GitHub and package manager metrics, and each entry gives a short description, licence and activity signals. It is maintained by the ps-wiki community, started by Jinning Wang with Mohamed Numair and Paulo Meira, and anyone can propose additions through issues or edits to the projects file. Coverage is worldwide open-source software. The list is a README on GitHub with the underlying projects.yaml, and weekly snapshots are archived on Zenodo, under CC-BY-SA-4.0 at no cost. Caveats: ranking reflects popularity, not quality or validation, and it covers only projects with public repositories. Simulation uses are finding network flow, optimisation and co-simulation tools; it is a discovery source for catalogue sweeps. Related records: it lists MATPOWER, ANDES, HELICS, PowSyBl, Dynawo, DPsim and GridStatus, catalogued as model-matpower, model-andes, platform-helics, platform-powsybl, platform-dynawo, model-dpsim and data-gridstatus.
